## What Dojo does

Dojo Design & Sourcing turns apparel briefs into garment concepts, CAD flats, and production-ready tech packs with measurement specs, BOMs, and construction details. The team develops prints and branding artwork, creates 3D samples for silhouette/fabric/colorway visualization, sources vetted factories, manages production follow-up, runs AQL quality control, packs for export, trucks sealed cargo to port, and coordinates ocean freight to US, EU, UK, and APAC hubs.

## Services

- Apparel Design & Tech Packs
- 3D Virtual Garment Sampling
- Factory Sourcing & Cut-and-Sew Production
- AQL 2.5 Quality Control & Export Packaging
- Inland Cargo Trucking & Port Drayage
- Ocean Freight (FCL / LCL) & Final Delivery

- Interactive 3D journey content on the homepage is a product visualization; factual claims live in About, FAQ, Showcase, and this document
